import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { redactions } from "../../../backend/schema/redactions";

// A board over "descriptionFormat" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "descriptionFormat", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const redactionsCms = customizeTable<typeof redactions>("redactions", {
    display: {
        title: "title"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "title", "descriptionFormat", "user", "description", "createdAt"],
    fields: {
        title: {
            multiline: true
        },
        description: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "title",
        "descriptionFormat",
        "user",
        "description",
        "createdAt",
        "updatedAt"
    ]
});
